audit_target: Investigation of Static Heavy Latency (14.501ms) vs Adaptive Cascade P99 (4.556ms)

static_heavy_measurement.boundary: Measures continuous, uninterrupted execution of the full multi-model heavy ensemble on every single frame.

adaptive_cascade_measurement.boundary: Measures end-to-end frame processing time across the adaptive cascade distribution.

causal_mechanism_verification.primary_mechanism: Evidential Load Shedding: 48.0% of frames bypass secondary execution entirely (1.264ms latency). 43.9% of medium-risk frames execute fast verification (3.786ms latency). Only the remaining 8.1% severe tail approaches the heavy execution budget.
causal_mechanism_verification.queue_depth: Under nominal frame ingestion (lambda <= 200 Hz), the amortized service rate mu = 373.3 FPS easily clears incoming traffic, preventing queue buildup and bounding P99 latency to 4.556ms (< 5.0ms SLA).
causal_mechanism_verification.claim_qualification: Manuscript must explain latency reduction via evidential load shedding and amortized queue service rate, rather than assuming unmeasured hardware concurrency.
